# Tax Documentation: Revoke Tax Documentation Request

Area overview and notes: [tax-documentation.md](../tax-documentation.md)

`DELETE /account-owners/{id}/tax-documentation-data/resubmission-requests/{document_type}` · tenant-scoped token

Withdraws an open request for new tax documentation of the given `document_type`, clearing `needs_resubmission` on that questionnaire. The `ACCOUNT_OWNER_TAX_DOCUMENTATION_STATUS` webhook reports the change.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |
| `document_type` | The type of tax documentation whose open request should be withdrawn. One of: `W-9`, `W-8BEN`, `W-8BEN-E`, `W-8IMY`, `SELF_CERTIFICATION`, `DPS`. |

**Response 204**: Request withdrawn

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 404 The Account Owner cannot be found, has no tax documentation of the given `document_type` on file, or has no open documentation request for it. · 429 Too Many Requests
